_approach: Half-time breakdown: the kick drops to once every two beats, a single clap lands only on beat 3, and a sparse hi-hat/rim texture keeps the tempo legible without the full-time bounce — the arrangement's deepest lull before the build-up returns the double-time energy. Ref: Music Production Wiki's build-tension-and-drops guide (half-time as a macro-tension device), EDMProd's build-up guide. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
